title: Gradescope rubric items
description: Rubric items per question, as exported/imported by the Gradescope Outline & Rubric JSON userscript. Import SYNCS each listed question's rubric to match the file: scoring type, groups and items are added, edited, moved and reordered, and (after a separate confirmation) existing items and groups that are missing from the file are deleted. Questions not listed are untouched.

question.description: The question's number as shown in Gradescope, e.g. "1", "1.1", "4.12". Used to find the question.

title.description: The question's title. Optional safety check: if present and different from the title in Gradescope, the entry is skipped.

scoring_type.description: How the question is scored: "negative" = subtract points (rubric items deduct from the question's points), "positive" = add points. If it differs from the current setting on import, the question's scoring type is changed. Omit to leave it unchanged.

items.description: Rubric entries in display order (first = top): plain items and groups. Groups share one ordering with ungrouped items. An item that appears in a different place than it has now (another group, or ungrouped) is moved. Include the default "Correct" item (weight 0) if it should be kept; any existing item or group that is not listed is deleted on import (with confirmation).

description.description: Text shown to graders for this rubric item. Supports full Markdown (bold, italics, inline code, lists, and fenced code blocks with a language tag such as ```java, used only for multi-line code) and LaTeX math between $$ and $$. Escape backslashes and newlines in JSON.

weight.description: Points as a non-negative number. Gradescope stores weights as positive numbers regardless of scoring type; the question's scoring_type decides whether the item adds or deducts.

mutually_exclusive.description: If true, graders can apply at most one item from the group.

items.description: Items inside the group, in order. A group needs at least one item.
